_: plan-11324 S3b (#58435; seed #59953/#59954): the SCOPE of every unit init.sh units() writes, declared once. `org`: each org in a cog runs its own; in a cog of several orgs its file is instance-named `<stem>@<org>.<suffix>` (an instance FILE, not a %i template: each org's content differs, its HOME and its .env), so two orgs never write the same unit. `cog`: one per cog (the gateway routes by to_org, the observatory lists every org, canvas rides the observatory's /canvas/: #58435 S3c's declared cog-scoped set); an ORG's units() run never writes one in a cog of several orgs. `port`: the fixed port a unit binds, a host-wide name like a tmux socket. In a cog of several orgs a per-org unit that binds a port takes it from its registry entry (S3b 5/n); until then it is NOT written there, with its reason. `cog_ready`: a COG-scoped unit the cog's own units() run writes (S3c 2/n: units() in a cog of several orgs with NO HOME carried is the cog's run, never an org's), under its plain name; a cog-scoped unit without it is not served in a cog yet and is not written, with its reason. One org: nothing here is read, every unit is what it was. A stem units() writes that is absent here fails the oracle (tests/test_org_home_units.py).
